verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships AI agents, so letting users connect external MCP servers to those agents is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents HubSpot acting as an MCP server that exposes CRM data and the Developer Platform to outside AI tools. Nothing shows HubSpot's own agents or Breeze Assistant connecting to user-supplied MCP servers, and server-side support does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
